execution.forward: ordinary dense FFN for every token
execution.backward: custom active-row-only FFN matrix multiplications; inactive FFN-path input gradients exactly zero; residual-path gradients intact
execution.deployment: ordinary dense inference without masks or custom execution

full_cost_accounting.reason: MPS FlopCounterMode misses standard backward FLOPs, including all standard FFN backward in an isolated dense FFN test; custom and dense paths therefore cannot be compared using MPS counters alone
full_cost_accounting.auxiliary_operations: reported separately and included in matched-cost interpolation
full_cost_accounting.mps_visible_counters: retained as diagnostics only, never as full training costs

dense_fewer_quality_reference: results-program/level3-75/body6/dense-fewer_seed9406.json; held-out loss 1.1832916910576354 on the same newly generated data; only quality is reused, not its undercounted MPS cost
primary_endpoint: ordinary dense held-out loss of low_max_abs_update versus random_update and dense-fewer at full CPU-calibrated matched total cost
secondary_endpoints: MPS-visible versus full CPU-calibrated cost diagnostics

decision_rules.no_level_3: low_max_abs_update beats random_update but not dense-fewer
decision_rules.development_level_3: low_max_abs_update beats dense-fewer at final and exact interpolated full cost and beats random_update
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

using sparse-deployment loss as the primary endpoint
using earlier MPS-only totals as full costs
changing the custom backward, activity, steps, or evaluation after launch
